newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares end off highs in thin pre-Xmas market.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares end off highs in thin pre-Xmas market.

text.p: Italian stocks ended a touch firmer on Monday but slipped off session highs due to slight late selling after a very thin session ahead of the Christmas holidays, traders said.
The Milan stock exchange will be closed until Friday.
The all-share Mibtel index ended up 0.25 percent at 10,487 after a session high at 10,512. The Mib30 blue chip index closed up 0.2 percent at 15,672 after a 15,723 high.
"It was a weak, trifling day dominated by book-squaring. I think Friday will be even worse," one trader said.
Traded volume was estimated at around 320 billion lire.

Shares in information technology group Olivetti rose strongly in very modest volume largely in a technical recovery from their recent poor performance, dealers said, closing 4.27 percent up at 528 lire after a 532 high.
Fiat ended 1.84 percent up at 4,210 lire but energy group ENI slipped 0.92 percent to 7,990.
Insurer INA, joint bidder with state-controlled bank BNL for a 60 percent stake in ailing Banco di Napoli, shed 1.02 percent to 1,936 lire.
Fiat-controlled Sorin Biomedica, which today said it had sold its nuclear medecine business to Amersham International Plc, ended 2.19 percent down at 5,460 lire.
